WITH inventory_date AS (
    SELECT max(DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        fi.ProductKey,
        sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) AS current_on_hand_quantity
    FROM retail.FactInventory fi
    INNER JOIN inventory_date id
        ON fi.DateKey = id.max_date
    GROUP BY fi.ProductKey
),
sales_last_90_days AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesQuantity) / 90.0 AS avg_daily_sales_qty_90d
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            SalesQuantity
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey BETWEEN toDate('2009-10-03') AND toDate('2009-12-31')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            SalesQuantity
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE DateKey BETWEEN toDate('2009-10-03') AND toDate('2009-12-31')
    )
    GROUP BY ProductKey
)
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    ci.current_on_hand_quantity,
    s.avg_daily_sales_qty_90d,
    ci.current_on_hand_quantity / s.avg_daily_sales_qty_90d AS days_inventory_coverage
FROM current_inventory ci
INNER JOIN sales_last_90_days s
    ON ci.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p
    ON p.ProductKey = ci.ProductKey
WHERE s.avg_daily_sales_qty_90d > 0
ORDER BY days_inventory_coverage ASC, p.ProductKey
LIMIT 20
